name: Hesrai
title: One of David's mighty warriors
summary: Hesrai from Carmel was one of King David's thirty mighty warriors. He is mentioned in the lists of David's heroes who distinguished themselves in battle and served faithfully during David's rule over Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Hesrai from Carmel is listed among David's thirty mighty men who excelled in service to the king.

keyEvents.title: Listed in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Hesrai is also mentioned in First Chronicles' parallel list of David's brave warriors.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's elite force
keyEvents.description: David's thirty heroes formed an elite group of warriors known for their bravery and loyalty, and Hesrai was part of this honored group.

keyEvents.title: Service during David's reign
keyEvents.description: As one of the thirty heroes, Hesrai served in David's army during the period when the united kingdom of Israel was established and strengthened.
